args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail.

## Change
- Updated `round_money` in `src/money.py` to quantize to cents with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `test_half_even` (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
